name: Sangkaya Toast
description: Thick white bread toasted and spread with homemade pandan coconut egg jam, a Thai café morning favourite.
ingredients: a handful of fresh mint, chopped
a drizzle of crispy fried shallots
instructions: Gather and prep the glutinous rice and large prawns, measuring everything out so it is ready to go.
Heat coconut oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat until warm but not smoking.
Add the sliced lemongrass and Thai eggplant, cooking gently until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the large prawns, season with dried shrimp, and cook until just done, about 5 mins.
Warm the glutinous rice alongside, turning once, until heated through and lightly toasted.
Plate the glutinous rice and spoon the cooked mixture over the top.
tips: Keep the heat moderate so the large prawns cooks through gently without drying out or turning rubbery.
A squeeze of citrus or a sprinkle of mint just before serving brightens up the whole plate.
